result.title: CLEAR: Cooperative Latent Flow for Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Accurate Region Preservation
result.summary: Visual counterfactual explanations (VCEs) should alter a classifier's prediction while remaining realistic and preserving decision-irrelevant content. Image-space methods provide high-quality counterfactuals but are computationally costly, whereas latent-space methods are more efficient but often less faithful. We identify two sources responsible for this gap. First, latent generation recovers a natural sample from a perturbed representation, whereas classifier guidance pushes it toward a target class, so their update directions may oppose. Second, VAE reconstruction can alter regions that should remain unchanged. We introduce CLEAR, a latent Flow Matching framework for VCEs. CLEAR uses Flow Matching's explicit instantaneous velocity as a reference for the generative direction to decompose classifier guidance into cooperative and conflicting components. It preserves the cooperative component and adaptively attenuates only the conflicting one according to conflict strength. We further analyze conflict frequency and strength throughout generation to reveal how classifier guidance interacts with the generative process. CLEAR also dynamically identifies editable regions, constrains latent modifications, and directly preserves factual content outside them to reduce VAE-induced changes. Across five bidirectional tasks on two datasets, CLEAR retains latent-space efficiency while achieving counterfactual quality comparable to or better than strong image-space baselines, with a 2.5x speedup over the strongest baseline. Project page: https://yan-zen9.github.io/CLEAR/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CLEAR，一个基于 latent Flow Matching 的视觉反事实解释框架：将分类器引导按 Flow Matching 的瞬时速度方向分解为协作与冲突成分，保留协作分量、按冲突强度自适应衰减冲突分量，并动态圈定可编辑区域以抑制 VAE 重建对无关区域的改动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成方向与任务引导方向相冲突」的分解与自适应衰减，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新与答案引导的融合、避免信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；可编辑区域约束与区域外内容保持也可能类比推理中应保留的视觉细节。
